preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products n must be non-negative and less than m, and m must be at most 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(forbidden) == n and all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden)
preconditions.description: The list of forbidden prefix products must contain exactly n distinct integers, each between 0 and m - 1.

postconditions.description: The length of the output sequence must be equal to k.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output sequence must be an integer between 0 and m - 1.

postconditions.expression: len(set(prefix_products)) == k and all(x not in forbidden for x in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: All prefix products of the sequence modulo m must be distinct and none of them can appear in the forbidden list.
The length k of the sequence must be maximized given the constraints.
